summary: Implemented E3052, E3053 and E3054 as keyword rules in src/cfnlint/rules/resources/ecs (ServiceNetworkConfiguration.py, TaskDefinitionAwsVpc.py, ServiceFargate.py) with matching unit tests in test/unit/rules/resources/ecs (test_service_network_configuration.py, test_task_definition_aws_vpc.py, test_service_fargate.py). The ECS tests pass (71), and the rules and rules-collection tests pass (1009). Nothing was committed. Caveats: the venv imports cfnlint from a different tree, so I ran tests with PYTHONPATH=src. test_formatters.py fails to collect because defusedxml is missing from the shared venv; I did not install it. Snapshot tests were not run, and black/ruff were not available, so line lengths were checked manually. E3052 emits at most one error per service and task-definition pair, which resolves a conflict in the spec.
